messages.subject: !! May Institute - Computation and statistics for mass spectrometry and proteomics at Northeastern University in Boston
parts:
Dear MSstats Users,

I am pleased to announce that May institute - Computation and statistics for mass spectrometry and proteomics at NEU in 2017 has opened the application. Details are available in https://computationalproteomics.ccis.northeastern.edu/

It is great opportunity for MSstats users to discuss with MSstats teams. Also there are more interesting topics for bench scientist and bioinformaticians. Deadline for application is February 10, 2017. We look forward to seeing you at this course.

- Meena
